spec_items.body: ATK has an image-map role: https://docs.gtk.org/atk/enum.Role.html#image_map. This role should be applied to image maps. It would be great if the HTML-AAM could include this in its mappings. Regarding implementations: * Chromium already uses the correct role (and has for quite some time). * Gecko does not, but should. * Orca is expecting the image-map role; not the image role.
